entries.en: to wait, to await (i.e., esperar)
entries.notes: M 栏 'têng : rrông' 第二读无汉字对应，未据以另立义项。

entries.en: to wait for, to await
to wait a moment, to wait a little while
to stop and wait, to halt one's steps
to wait a while, to wait some time

entries.zh: 听候，等候（“听”取听而待之之义）
entries.en: to await, to wait for (lit. to listen for)
to await (orders), to wait upon

entries.zh: 听便，随时待命（等候而准备就绪）
entries.en: to wait, being ready and prepared; to await another's convenience
entries.notes: L 末尾 'apa…' 截断（应为 aparejado），据 H 栏“听便”定“准备就绪、听候”义。

entries.zh: 听差，等候差遣（等着看被派往何处）
entries.en: to await assignment, to wait to see where one is sent
to wait

entries.zh: 等齐，同等等候（等到齐备）
entries.en: to wait for all alike, to wait until all are assembled
entries.notes: 'ygualmente' 与“等齐”非严格对译，语义由四栏推得。

entries.en: to await, to wait for
to await

entries.zh: 慢待，慢慢等候；引申为怠慢、招待不周
entries.en: to wait slowly, to be slow to attend; also to slight, to neglect a guest
entries.notes: H 栏“待慢”兼有怠慢义，L 仅作 aguardar, despacio，故以“慢慢等候”为主。

entries.en: to await the right time, to bide one's time
to wait for the appointed time

entries.zh: 留，留待他时（等候另有时机）
entries.en: to keep for another time, to wait for another occasion
to hold on a little longer, to wait a little while (lit. 'leave a few grains')
entries.notes: H 栏“留幾粒”于“稍等”义费解，“粒”疑为量词借喻少许或原稿讹写。

entries.zh: 留宿，寄住（留带＝留住、寄宿）
entries.en: to stay, to lodge, to put up (while waiting)

entries.zh: 流涎，垂涎（久候而口涎自流，如马嚼勒待行之状）
entries.en: to slaver, to drool (from long waiting, like a horse champing at the bit)
entries.notes: L 为“如马嚼勒而久候”之喻（ut mascando freno），H 栏“涎流”取其流涎之象。

entries.zh: 安命，听天由命（等候时运）
entries.en: to await one's fortune, to be resigned to one's lot
entries.notes: L 'aguardar ventura'（候运）与 H 栏“安命”（安于命）语义相邻而非严格对译。

entries.en: to wait a moment longer, a little while more
